clips.title: The story
paras: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon serves as the Regent of Stormwind and Supreme Commander of its armed forces following the mysterious disappearance of King Varian Wrynn. Standing beside the young boy-king Anduin Wrynn in Stormwind Keep, he strives to hold the kingdom together amid escalating domestic turmoil. Though fiercely honorable, Bolvar often finds his martial decisions influenced and stalled by royal advisor Lady Katrana Prestor.

When King Varian vanished en route to a peace summit on Theramore Isle, Stormwind was thrown into political disarray. Ten-year-old Prince Anduin was crowned to maintain continuity, but actual governing power fell to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon as Regent. Bolvar is a venerated paladin devoted to the crown, yet he faces immense strain. Stormwind's military is thinly stretched across Westfall, Redridge, and Duskwood. Compounding these crises, Bolvar frequently defers to the counsel of Lady Katrana Prestor, whose dismissive advice consistently blocks him from committing royal troops to peripheral towns.
